functions.name: destroyTimeoutRegistry
functions.notes: Walks the list at 8569340; clears each node callback, dispatches vtable slot 4 when the callback is its own base object and slot 5 otherwise, frees callback and node, then frees and clears the auxiliary block at 8569332.

validation.comparison: Four registry shapes: empty list, one callback-free node, two nodes with one vtable-slot-5 callback, and three nodes with a second callback plus an auxiliary block. Each compares complete 67,108,864-byte memory and the stack pointer.
limitations: The self-based vtable slot 4 branch is implemented but not exercised because a node cannot simultaneously act as its own vtable without corrupting the successor chain.
Ledger: 205 server bodies recovered and 529 remain machine code.
